# LevitateOS

> LevitateOS is a Linux distribution where you maintain your own packages. Packages are Rhai scripts called "recipes" that declare how to acquire, build and install each piece of software, and every recipe runs inside an isolated Ginux domain. The installed system updates atomically: A/B slots are the default, each update is trial-booted before it is kept, and mutable mode is an explicit opt-in.

LevitateOS targets power users who want full control over their system. It follows the Arch Linux philosophy of a manual, step-by-step installation from a live ISO, but takes its core system pre-built from signed packages and replaces the traditional package manager with recipes.

Variants (built by the same pipeline):
- **LevitateOS**: glibc, systemd, GNU. Core system from signed Fedora 45 RPMs. Maximum compatibility.
- **AcornOS**: musl, OpenRC, busybox. Core system from Alpine Linux APKs. A smaller, simpler base.

Hardware baseline: x86-64-v3 (Intel Haswell or AMD Zen or newer), 16 GB RAM, NVMe disk, UEFI with Secure Boot disabled. First releases are planned for 2027, x86_64 first.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started): Download the live ISO and create installation media
- [Installation](/docs/installation): The installation steps at a glance
- [Disk Preparation](/docs/installation-disk): Partition the disk with recpart (A/B layout by default)
- [Base System](/docs/installation-base): Extract the system with recstrap and write fstab with recfstab
- [Configuration](/docs/installation-config): Time zone, locale, keymap, hostname and users with recsetup
- [Bootloader & Finish](/docs/installation-boot): systemd-boot and the A/B boot entries, then reboot
- [Post-Installation](/docs/post-installation): First boot, networking and A/B updates
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues and solutions

## Package Manager

- [CLI Reference](/docs/cli-reference): recipe install, remove, cleanup, isinstalled, isbuilt, isacquired, list, info
- [Recipe Format](/docs/recipe-format): RECIPE_API 2 recipes: package facts, readiness checks and acquire/build/install hooks

## Rhai Helper Functions

- [Helpers Overview](/docs/helpers-overview): Functions available to recipe scripts
- [Acquire Helpers](/docs/helpers-acquire): download, git_checkout, github_download_release, checksum verification
- [Build Helpers](/docs/helpers-build): extract, extract_with_format and the target_* package-extraction helpers
- [Install Helpers](/docs/helpers-install): copy_file, copy_tree_contents and the dnf/apk package helpers
- [Filesystem Helpers](/docs/helpers-filesystem): is_file, is_dir, mkdir, read_file, write_file, ln, rm, chmod
- [Environment Helpers](/docs/helpers-environment): env, command_exists and logging
- [Command Helpers](/docs/helpers-commands): exec, exec_checked, exec_output, shell, shell_in
- [HTTP Helpers](/docs/helpers-http): http_get, github_latest_release, github_latest_tag
- [Path Helpers](/docs/helpers-paths): join_path, basename, dirname and string helpers

## Architecture

- [Architecture FAQ](/docs/faq): Design decisions
- [How We Compare](/docs/how-we-compare): Comparison with Arch, NixOS, Gentoo and Alpine
- [Atomic Updates (A/B)](/docs/atomic-updates): Two system slots, trial boot, commit and rollback
- [Variants](/docs/variants): LevitateOS and AcornOS

## rec* Tooling

- [rec* Tooling Overview](/docs/rec-tooling-overview): Every rec* tool and what it does
- [Installation Tools Overview](/docs/installation-tools-overview): The tools used during installation
- [recpart](/docs/recpart): Partition planning and apply (like a scripted fdisk)
- [recstrap](/docs/recstrap): Extract the system image to a target directory (like pacstrap)
- [recfstab](/docs/recfstab): Generate fstab from mounted filesystems (like genfstab)
- [recsetup](/docs/recsetup): Configure an extracted system: time zone, locale, accounts, boot, services
- [recchroot](/docs/recchroot): Enter a chroot with the right bind mounts (like arch-chroot)
- [recab](/docs/recab): A/B slot manager: stage, trial boot, commit, rollback
- [recinit](/docs/recinit): Rootless initramfs builder
- [recuki](/docs/recuki): Unified Kernel Image builder
- [reciso](/docs/reciso): Bootable UEFI ISO builder
- [recqemu](/docs/recqemu): Runs test VMs as libvirt domains
